proof:
intro N inst hN g hprod
have hp := (M8.MixedNonproduct.product_action N g (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N)).mp hprod
have hr := (M8.MixedNonproduct.product_rectangular N (M8.MixedFamily.recipe N)).mp hp
